Authors: Denis Hartmann, Artemijs Krimovs, Oussama Errida, Tiberiu-M. Gianga, Giuliano Siligardi, Robert Pal, Timothy A. Barendt

A coronene diimide with α-chiral imide groups was synthesised. This molecule self-assembles into strongly CD and CPL active assemblies, which retain activity in thin films.

DOI: 10.1039/d6sc06148f

item.title: Symmetric dual-interphase design enables stable lithium-metal anodes for high rate ultrahigh-nickel all-solid-state batteries
item.description:
Authors: Chen Liu, Zhuolin Zhong, Lin Li, Siwu Li, Qiyue Luo, Haojie Zhang, Xia Chen, Chuang Yu, Kai Jiang

An asymmetric dual-interphase couples fast lithium-ion transport with homogenized electron distribution, suppressing dendrite-induced short circuits and enabling high-rate NCM955-based all-solid-state lithium metal batteries.

DOI: 10.1039/d6sc06840e

item.title: Exploring the excited state mechanisms of a viscosity-sensitive zeromethine merocyanine dye emitter
item.description:
Authors: Julian Fichtner, Preetika Verma, Menyhárt Sárosi, Matthias Stolte, Yapamanu Adithya Lakshmanna, Frank Würthner

A viscosity-sensitive zeromethine merocyanine dye displays multifaceted environment-dependent photoluminescence consisting of TICT emission, fluorescence and phosphorescence, depending on the accessibility to torsional motions.

DOI: 10.1039/d6sc05772a

item.title: Phosphoric acid-etched boron nitride as a single-atom support for boosting CO 2 electroreduction at high current density
item.description:
Authors: Xuan Li, Yu-Ting Wang, Wei-Zhen Deng, Qian-Run Tan, Hong-Mei Liu, Wen-Juan Huang, Li-Dong Wang, Zi-Xuan Wu, Yuan-Jing Suo, Yan-Tong Xu, Li-Ming Cao, Hai-Hua Huang, Chun-Ting He

A defective and phosphate-modified boron nitride support boosts efficient electrocatalytic CO 2 reduction with Ni single atoms.

DOI: 10.1039/d6sc06494a
